rationale: T7 requires a binary classifier for early-warning identification of high-cost claims (top 5% by paid_amount) suitable for nurse review. Plan follows statistical best practices: (1) loads medical_claims table; (2) splits 75/25 (test_size=0.25) to hold out a quarter as specified; (3) defines target as paid_amount > 95th percentile computed on training data only to avoid leakage and reflect realistic deployment; (4) selects clinically and operationally relevant features available at claim submission (claim type, service location, provider discipline, clinical indicators, cost signals) while excluding identifiers (claim_id, member_id) and post-adjudication fields to prevent overfitting and information leakage; (5) fits encoder and scaler on training data only for proper generalization validation; (6) trains logistic regression and random forest as specified to enable comparison; (7) generates ranking metrics (PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, precision/recall at top 5%) and standard artifacts. Retrieved skill on denial-rate denominators does not apply to cost prediction modeling.
